product.description:
Veria Flexicable 10 has a running power of 10W per meter. Together with the low installation height of only 4mm, it makes the Veria Flexicable 10 perfect for refurbishing existing floors. Veria Flexicable 100 can be laid directly on combustible subfloor.

Features:
4 mm installation height
10 W per meter
Can be laid directly on a combustible subfloor
Aluminium screen (100% shielded)
CE marked in accordance with EN 60335-1 and 60335-2-96

Assembly: The cable can be laid directly on the substrate and attached most easily using double-sided tape or similar, but can also be attached with a glue gun. Note that this product must be installed by an authorized electrical installer.

Guidelines for selecting the right output:
For concrete floors with carpet, laminate, vinyl, parquet or wooden top flooring max. 60-100W/m² is recommended
For concrete floors with tiles on top max. 150W/m² is recommended

Veria Flexicable can be used with the following thermostats:
Veria Control B35/45
Veria Control T45
Veria Control W35/45

Available in internal diameters from 6 mm up to 152 mm and lengths from 50 mm to 950 mm, they cover everything from compact engine bays to large industrial installations. Rated for continuous use at high temperatures and withstanding working pressures of up to 10 Bar (depending on size), they’re ideal for custom builds, replacements, or performance upgrades. Each hose is precision-moulded to ensure a secure fit and optimal flow. Built to SAEJ20 industry standards and compatible with most fluids, these couplers are trusted by professionals for motorsport, marine, automotive, and manufacturing use. Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.name: Press Female Adapter MLCP WRAS Approved Fittings - 20mm x 1/2" - Pack of 10
product.description:
MLCP Press Female Adaptor is designed to provide a secure transition from multilayer composite pipe (MLCP) to a female threaded connection. Ideal for connecting to valves, manifolds, or other threaded components, this adaptor allows easy integration of MLCP pipework with standard BSP fittings.  Manufactured from high-quality brass and fitted with durable sealing O-rings and a 304 stainless steel press sleeve, the adaptor delivers excellent strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term reliability. Fully compliant with EN ISO 21003 and WRAS approved, press female adaptors are suitable for potable water and heating applications in both domestic and commercial installations.

product.name: Bar Original The Big Pipe Port Wine Brandy Sipper Glass
product.description: The BIG Pipe Sipper Glass (250ml) The bowl of the pipe will express the aroma of your drink while you sip through the narrow pipe tube. The original pipe glass featured on the bbc’s Great British Menu with great success. Now the NEW Big Pipe version is here! Large Enough to hold a smoking cocktail or regular mixer drink. Pipe up and sip your tipple with sophistication. Each glass is hand-crafted from tough borosilicate glass. Traditionally, port wine was served in sipping pipes, which look like large glass Smoking pipes, such as this. The stem of the pipe acts like a straw, so you sip the wine from the bottom, drinking the port that hasn’t been exposed to air. This way, most of the liquid is untouched by oxygen, reducing oxidation and preserving the wine’s original, intended flavour. Port sippers date back to the 17th century. Perfect for. .. Use with brandy, port and many other types of liqueurs and spirits. Mixer drinks. Holding 250ml there is enough capacity for a stylish-looking mixer drink! Creating Smoking cocktails. If you know how or want to start making smoking cocktails, this glass being pipe shaped is the perfect-looking glass! Drink Port The traditional way. Sip from the spout and appreciate the rich, full-bodied flavour of the unoxidised drink as it feeds from the bottom of the glass. Specifications Glass Dimensions: 17 x 9 x 6. 5cm. Glass Capacity: 250ml. Material: Borosilicate glass. Cleaning: Handwash only. Features Enhances the flavour of your drink. Made from tough borosilicate glass. How to Make a Port and Tonic Cocktail Fill the glass with a Port and Tonic (Porto Tonico) cocktail. A light, slightly sweet and refreshing cocktail that’s easy to make. Method Add 2 ice cubes to the glass. Pour one part Port with 2 parts Tonic Water. Wash and slice the orange. Add an orange slice to the glass. Top with a sprig of mint. Ingredients Port Wine Tonic Water Orange Mint

product.name: 16mm Ultra Flexible PERT EVOH Pipe - 100m
product.description: Lightweight and ultra-flexible, Fastwarm EVOH Pert barrier pipe is the ideal solution for large installations where the absence of a metal layer makes it less taxing to bend and install than Pert-Al-Pert pipe without sacrificing performance.  Our 16mm EVOH pert pipe is manufactured to ISO9001 standards ensuring outstanding performance & reliability in all types of warm water underfloor heating systems.  EVOH PE-RT pipe consists of 3 layers which is made up of an oxygen barrier (EVOH), a layer of adhesive, and an inner layer of pert pipe.  The oxygen diffusion barrier encases the inner layer of PE-RT pipe completely to prevent the entry of oxygen into the heating system through the pipe. product.name: 12mm 2 Metre PVC Clear Plastic Flexible Hose Pipe With FREE Stainless Steel Clips
product.description:
This Unreinforced PVC Hose represents a flexible and economical choice for low-pressure fluid and air transfer. Fabricated from high-grade soft polyvinyl chloride (PVC), it combines lightweight maneuverability with high transparency, making it easy to visually monitor flow in water, air, and mild chemical applications. With a comprehensive size range from 3mm to 25mm internal diameter, this tubing is adaptable to a wide variety of domestic, laboratory, and industrial requirements.

Designed for efficiency, the hose features a smooth bore and consistent wall thickness to ensure reliable flow rates, while its unreinforced nature ensures it remains lightweight and easy to install. It performs consistently in temperatures ranging from -10°C to +65°C, capable of withstanding short-term peaks up to +70°C. The hose offers excellent pliability, supporting bend radii between 20mm and 180mm depending on the bore size. With a working pressure rating of 1.5 Bar and a burst limit of 4.5 Bar, it is robust enough for most general-purpose tasks. Whether used for garden irrigation, PC water cooling loops, or workshop air routing, this clear hose offers a durable, clean, and practical solution.

product.name: 51mm 2 Metre Clear Aquatic/Fishpond Filter, Pump or Waterfall Flexible Reinforced Hose/Pipe, Drainage Hose for Pools and Hot Tubs
product.description: This Clear PVC Corrugated Hose is a durable and flexible solution for moving water, air, or light chemicals. Designed with a smooth internal wall for efficient flow and a tough corrugated outer layer for added strength and flexibility, it’s ideal for pond systems, water pumps, filtration, and general fluid transfer. The clear design allows easy visual inspection of contents, while the UV-resistant construction makes it suitable for outdoor use. Reinforced with a high-tensile plastic rib, this hose maintains excellent structural integrity under pressure and resists kinking even when bent to tight radii. It performs in temperatures from -10°C to +65°C, with peak resistance up to +70°C. Available in sizes from 19mm to 50mm inner diameter, it supports working pressures up to 5 Bar and burst pressures up to 15 Bar depending on the size. Coils are supplied in 30m or 50m lengths, offering efficient installation for large or small setups. Manufactured to BS EN ISO 3994-2001, this hose delivers long-term reliability in commercial, industrial, or garden environments.

product.name: Layflat Discharge Hose Pipe Yellow 63mm ID PVC Polyester Reinforced Submersible Pump Compatible, 2m and 2 Hose Clips

With a 3:1 safety factor and an operating temperature of -60°C to +180°C, the clips are built to last in demanding environments without the need for additional fasteners.

product.name: Clear Braided Hose Kit 13mm (1/2") Bore 2m PVC Tube Plastic Joiner 2 Stainless Steel Clips Reinforced Air Water Irrigation Pipe
product.description: This kit pairs a 2 metre cut length of 13mm internal diameter clear PVC braided hose with the matching 13mm plastic straight joiner and 2 stainless steel worm drive hose clips, so a run can be extended, repaired or joined straight out of the box. The hose is reinforced with triple polyester yarn between soft PVC inner and outer walls, giving stable pressure handling and good kink resistance while staying flexible enough to route around obstacles. The 2.5mm wall supports a working pressure of up to 7 bar with a 3:1 burst safety factor, and the transparent construction lets flow and contents be inspected at a glance. Operating range is -10C to +65C with a +70C peak, and the hose is compliant with ISO 5774:2016 Type A. The barbed joiner pushes into both hose ends and is secured by the two supplied clips for a leak-free connection. Typical uses include pneumatic tools and air lines, water and irrigation feeds, pond and aquarium plumbing, workshop coolant lines and general light chemical transfer. Supplied under the Hoses UK brand.

product.name: VRUC Bathroom Shower Enclosure Hinged Door with Side Panel 760 x 800mm Chrome
product.description:
This set pairs a hinged shower door with a dedicated side panel, perfect for turning recesses or corners into a full, neat shower enclosure—especially great for smaller bathrooms. The hinged door pivots on silky-smooth hinges, so it doesn’t take up extra space when opening but still gives a wide entry width for easy in-and-out. It has a minimalist frameless design that keeps the look clean, and both the door and side panel use 6mm thick toughened glass for strong durability. At 1900mm tall, they work together to trap shower splashes, keeping your bathroom floor dry.

Specification​
Glass: 6mm thick toughened safety glass, certified to CE and BS EN 12150 standards; easy-clean coating on the inner side.​
Frame & Hardware: High-quality polished chrome aluminum profiles for both pieces. The hinged door includes brass hinges (for smooth pivoting), stainless-steel handles, and a magnetic seal (for watertight closure).​
Installation: Left or right-hand fitting option for both door and side panel, easy to set up. 20mm out-of-true wall adjustment per side for each component (adapts to uneven walls).​
Dimensions:​
Height (door & side panel): 1900mm (uniform for both)​
Hinged door width: 760mm (adjustable range from 740mm to 780mm)​
Hinged door entry width: 630mm​
Side panel width: 800mm​
Included in Package: 1 x hinged shower door; 1 x side panel.​
Not Included: Shower tray (needs to be purchased separately).

product.name: 32mm to 45mm (1 1/4" To 1 3/4") Plastic Hose Connector White Barbed Hose Connector for Garden Hoses, Pond Hoses, Water Pipes
product.description:
This Plastic 45 Degree Reducer Barbed Joiner is designed to connect two hoses of different internal diameters while providing a smooth 45° directional change. Ideal for garden irrigation, pond systems, water transfer lines, and general fluid applications, it allows flexible routing where space is limited or where a gentle angle is required to reduce hose strain.

Manufactured from durable ABS plastic, this fitting offers reliable strength while remaining lightweight and easy to install. This component is a precision 3D printed ABS part, produced for accurate sizing and dependable performance. The barbed ends provide a secure push-fit connection inside flexible hose, helping to minimise leaks and maintain consistent flow. The reducer design enables connection between two different hose sizes without the need for additional adapters.

The 45-degree angle supports improved hose routing compared to straight connectors, helping reduce kinking and stress on pipework. Suitable for use with PVC hose, rubber hose, and other flexible pipe systems, this joiner performs reliably in outdoor and wet environments. Resistant to water and general wear, it provides dependable performance for both DIY users and professional installers. Whether adapting hose sizes or changing direction within a system, this reducer barbed joiner offers a practical and efficient solution.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend - 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° swivel bends create a tight-radius 45° change of direction in soil and waste systems. These spigot-to-socket solvent weld fittings have a long tail for insertion into another fitting and are supplied in a pack of two. Made from durable ABS, they are manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and are kitemarked. For solvent weld installation, clean pipe and fitting, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 12 hours before testing. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement. Solvent weld joints are permanent.

product.name: FloPlast 90 Degree Solvent Weld Swivel Waste Bend M&F, 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: Pack of two 40mm ABS swivel waste bends to create a compact 90° change of direction in domestic waste pipe systems. Commonly called M and F or spigot bends, each fitting has a long tail to insert into a socket for solvent-weld jointing. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked. For solvent welding, ensure pipe and fitting are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push and twist fully home, wipe away excess and allow 5 minutes to set; leave 12 hours before testing. Solvent welds are permanent. Work in a well-ventilated area, keep cement away from heat and flames and avoid skin contact; wash with soap and water if contact occurs.

product.name: FloPlast Solvent Weld Waste Reducer 40mm x 32mm White Pack of 2
product.description: Solvent weld waste reducer to join a 32mm waste pipe into a 40mm pipe, commonly used where the smaller pipe drops into the larger pipe—such as the branch of a 40mm tee or one end of a 40mm coupling. Made from durable ABS and supplied as a pack of two. To install, ensure pipe and fitting surfaces are clean, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact, then wipe away excess cement and allow 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent; work in a well-ventilated area and avoid skin contact with solvent cement.

product.name: FloPlast 135 Degree Solvent Weld Waste Bend 40mm White - Pack of 2
product.description: 135° solvent weld waste bends change direction in waste pipe runs and can be used in pairs to create offsets. Available in 32mm, 40mm and 50mm sizes, this listing is for the 40mm option supplied as a pack of two. Manufactured in the UK to BS EN 1455-1:2000 and kitemarked, the ABS fittings use solvent weld jointing. To fit, ensure pipe and fitting are clean and free of grit, apply SC250 solvent cement to both surfaces, push the pipe fully into the fitting and twist to ensure full contact. Wipe away excess solvent, allow 5 minutes to set and leave the installation for 12 hours before testing. Solvent weld joints are permanent. Work in a well ventilated area and avoid contact with skin; if contact occurs, wash thoroughly with soap and water.
